name: CassU Fighters + Vel Omi
description:
While on paper, the Cassian Undercover squad should do very well, and the Dmg output is unreal, their Dmg immunity only lasts for 1 round.
Unfortunately they are a little too RNG early in the wave, and swarm attacks can kill Vel and make the entire team fall apart.
For the investment needed, this team comes out a bit short.
notes: Weak to swarm attacks on Vel
Must have the Omi and a set comp
